contract.method: authored native behavior contract with independent JS reference
contract.description: Replace every nonoverlapping literal occurrence of search with replacement. Replacement is literal: dollar signs have no special meaning. If search is empty, leave text unchanged. Do not rescan inserted text.
contract.domain: Strings are Unicode text of at most 128 code points. Lone surrogate code units are excluded. Search and replacement have the same text restrictions.

inputRoles.replacement: literal text inserted in place of matches

contract.outputRole: transformed source content, not a match count
contract.mutationPolicy: Do not modify inputs; array outputs must be fresh with independent storage.

documentation: Native semantics reviewed against VeraCompiler.ets and VeraUi.ets. These tasks are not translated upstream symbols.
